description:
Add BenchBox support for Tinybird as a native platform with its own `tinybird` key (not a gateway). Tinybird requires a dual-path adapter: schema/load go through the Data Source REST API (token auth, .tbl conversion, import-job polling) while queries go through the read-only ClickHouse HTTP interface.

Scope boundary: workspace-database prefixing, token scope requirements documented, no system-table parity claims, throughput streams only if the spike proves session independence. Docs must state the dual-path model and why Tinybird numbers are never comparable to native ClickHouse runs (different storage/ingest path, server-side materializations).

DECISION GATE: proceeds only after ch-tinybird-spike records go on all four unknowns (query path, ingest path, schema translation, namespace reality). A no-go defers this item with the spike evidence as the record.

Guardrails: manifest authority respected; lazy optional imports; compat-docs-check green; tokens in env only; read-only interface failures surfaced cleanly, never as false-success results.
